metadata.description: AG-UI spec for a Rust-native research agent with streaming text and tool call UI bindings
metadata.author: prometheus-skill-pack

agent.name: prometheus-research-agent
agent.description: A Rust-native research agent that performs RAG-backed knowledge retrieval and streams responses to the frontend via AG-UI protocol.

tools.name: search_knowledge_base
tools.description: Search the vector knowledge base for relevant context given a user query.

top_k.description: Maximum number of results to retrieve.

namespace.description: Optional knowledge base namespace to scope the search.

tools.name: synthesize_answer
tools.description: Synthesize a final answer from retrieved context and stream it back to the user.

context_ids.description: IDs of retrieved context chunks to include in synthesis.

user_query.description: The original user query being answered.

tools.name: update_shared_state
tools.description: Push a partial state update to the frontend to reflect agent progress.

value.description: New value for the state key. Any JSON-serializable type.

event_emission.condition: Emitted when the search tool begins executing. Renders a loading spinner in the SearchProgressIndicator slot.
Emitted when the search tool completes. Populates the SearchResultsPanel with retrieved context cards.
Emitted when answer synthesis begins. Activates the streaming text display in AnswerStreamContainer.
Emitted for each incremental text chunk during synthesis. Appended to the AnswerStreamContainer content.
Emitted when answer synthesis is complete. Locks the AnswerStreamContainer and reveals the copy/share controls.
Emitted when partial state is pushed to the frontend. Updates the AgentStatusBar to reflect current agent phase.
